SELECT DISTINCT cc.id, cc.class_name as className, cc.year, cc.capacity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_students cs WHERE cs.class_id = cc.id) as studentCount, c.id as courseId, c.course_name as courseName, cc.teacher_id as teacherId, u.name as teacherName, cc.major_id as majorId, m.major_name as majorName, cc_c.class_time as classTime, cc_c.class_location as classLocation FROM course_classes cc LEFT JOIN class_courses cc_c ON cc.id = cc_c.class_id LEFT JOIN courses c ON (cc_c.course_id = c.id OR (cc_c.course_id IS NULL AND cc.course_id = c.id)) LEFT JOIN users u ON (cc_c.teacher_id = u.id OR (cc_c.teacher_id IS NULL AND cc.teacher_id = u.id)) JOIN majors m ON cc.major_id = m.id WHERE (c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} OR cc_c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} OR cc.teacher_id = #{teacherId}) AND cc.class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{className}, '%') AND cc.year = #{grade} AND m.major_name = #{majorName} AND cc.major_id = #{majorId} AND u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{teacherName}, '%') AND (c.id = #{courseId} OR cc_c.course_id = #{courseId}) ORDER BY cc.id, c.id
